answer_spec: Columns: customer name, incidents on their shipments, approved claim amount on those incidents (approved or paid claims; 0 if none, rounded 2); customers with at least 4 incidents; ordered by incidents DESC, customer_id.
gold_sql: SELECT c.c03 AS c03, COUNT(*) AS incidents, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ic.c12 IN ('approved', 'paid') THEN ic.c11 END), 0), 2) AS approved_usd FROM t95g AS i JOIN tg6t AS fc ON fc.c01 = i.c02 JOIN t89v AS s ON s.c01 = fc.c02 JOIN th77 AS c ON c.c01 = s.c03 LEFT JOIN tm8a AS ic ON ic.c03 = i.c01 GROUP BY c.c01, c.c03 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4 ORDER BY incidents DESC, c.c01

question: For each airline, how often did a flight leave over an hour late right after the same plane's previous flight arrived over an hour late?

gold_sql: WITH c AS (SELECT s.c03 AS c03, a.c02 AS c02, COUNT(*) AS n FROM t89v AS s JOIN ts53 AS a ON a.c01 = s.c07 WHERE s.c22 <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY s.c03, a.c02), r AS (SELECT c.c03 AS c03, c.c02 AS c02, c.n AS n, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c03 ORDER BY c.n DESC, c.c02) AS rn, SUM(c.n) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c03) AS total FROM c AS c) SELECT cu.c03 AS c03, r.c02 AS top_destination, r.n AS shipments FROM r AS r JOIN th77 AS cu ON cu.c01 = r.c03 WHERE r.rn = 1 AND r.total >= 60 ORDER BY r.c03

question: For invoices paid in exactly two payments, how many days are there between the two, by type of customer?
question_template: For invoices paid in exactly two payments, how many days are there between the two, by type of customer?
answer_spec: Columns: customer_type, invoices paid in exactly two payments, average days between the first and second payment (rounded 1); ordered by customer_type.
gold_sql: WITH two AS (SELECT t8tg.c03 AS c03, MIN(t8tg.c05) AS first_pay, MAX(t8tg.c05) AS second_pay FROM t8tg AS t8tg GROUP BY t8tg.c03 HAVING COUNT(*) = 2) SELECT c.c04 AS c04, COUNT(*) AS two_part_invoices, ROUND(AVG(JULIANDAY(t.second_pay) - JULIANDAY(t.first_pay)), 1) AS avg_days_between FROM two AS t JOIN tajj AS i ON i.c01 = t.c03 JOIN t89v AS s ON s.c01 = i.c03 JOIN th77 AS c ON c.c01 = s.c03 GROUP BY c.c04 ORDER BY c04
